{"notes": "Visit 3, left at 5:30. Only what I saw and heard; I still don't know who placed which domino.

Picture: one unbroken dark chain from START (~28,4) along the top to the nose (~4.5,11), then back along the bottom to the tail tip (~27,15.3). No pale pieces or gaps are visible, so the whole fish looks connected to the start. The three strays at the nose are gone and the joint looks intact.

Omar: Spotted that the bottom line stopped short of the tail, announced he'd extend it, and asked for a shout if someone was already on it. At 5:15 he reported 'tail tip's done', which matches the chain now reaching the tail. He then flagged the risk to the nose joint from clearing strays and went to look. This is his first concrete, verified output and shows good initiative and awareness. I'm upgrading him from commentary-only: solid on execution, collaboration and impact.

Sofia: Handed the tail to Omar cleanly ('tail tip is yours') and took on cleanup, identifying and clearing three unconnected strays at the nose without breaking the joint. She planned a whole-fish check, but I didn't see that happen. Good judgment and coordination. Her bottom line stopped short of the tail, so credit for finishing it goes to Omar. Still solid, with no sign of a problem.

Jack: Silent this visit and I saw nothing. He said earlier he'd watch the bottom line for gaps, but Omar caught the shortfall. Execution still unverified.

Hana: Silent again, nothing seen across three visits. No basis to rate supply or anything else. Ask her directly.

Before final ratings: ask the team privately who built what, and whether anyone inspected the whole fish."}
